name: Cook Burgers
desc:
🎩 New CEO Package gamepass!
Make sure to visit the bank and the new hardware store!

🍔 Make your own burgers and manage the restaurant! 
🐀 Watch out for the rats, or find the strange potion to play as a rat! 

Tips: Ingredients will only stick when on a plate Hold E or hold the Flip button to flip the thing you're holding 
You can get your own VIP server for free!
